summary: Still range-bound: the headline indices barely move while mid and small caps keep their gains, so the market is marking time in a quiet mid-session.

detail.leaders: IT (mid-tier), PSU banks; NLC India; order-win small caps; MidCap +0.58%, SmallCap +0.74% (11 am)
detail.tone: No fresh index print since 11:00, when the Nifty was 22,697.20 (−0.08%) and the Sensex 72,687.77 (+0.22%). Reports still describe the indices as stuck in a range.
watch: A break of the range either way into the afternoon
